Name: Female Voice
Dialog: (whispering) I am ashparash!

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: (narrating) Our dimension is changed.

Name: Male Voice
Dialog: (also whispering) What's that?

Name: Female Voice
Dialog: (whispering) It's Elvish.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: (narrating) I feel it in the water.

Name: Male Voice
Dialog: (whispering) Yes, but what does it mean?

Name: Female Voice
Dialog: (whispering) It doesn't mean anything. It's a made-up language.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: (narrating) I feel it in the earth.

Name: Male Voice
Dialog: (whispering) Oh, then I want to try one.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: (narrating) I feel it in the little pieces of apple in my Waldorf salad.

Name: Female Voice
Dialog: (whispering) Go ahead.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: (narrating) Much of what once was...

Name: Male Voice
Dialog: (whispering) Sepulveda.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: (narrating) is lost.

Name: Female Voice
Dialog: (whispering) What?

Name: Male Voice
Dialog: (whispering) It's an exit off the 405.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: (narrating) For some now live who remember it the way it really happened.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: (narrating) Like all terrible things, it started with small-minded people who became great. Victory was near. But small things can also be good, and can work against evil, like how a tiny cat hair can ruin an evil sandwich. The great empire fell and fell some more. And what was once evil melted away and was replaced by the love of a choo-choo. Soon all discovered that there was more to life than vigilance. All but one.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (voiceover) War journal entry number... Uh, I mean, Dear Diary, It's been two months since the fall of Doofenshmirtz, but every morning I think I'm gonna wake up back in the underground. I feel restless. I need a challenge. I need a mission. I can feel myself getting softer. Doofenshmirtz is in jail and everyone is trying to embrace their new freedom. I alone know better. I can feel evil still out there, getting stronger while I sit in my room, waiting for the other shoe to drop.

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: Hey, guys! I think I stepped on a slug.

Name: Dr. Baljeet
Dialog: A slug, really?

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: Wait a sec. What do you call those things that eat nuts and live in trees?

Name: Dr. Baljeet
Dialog: A squirrel?

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: Yeah. It was definitely a slug.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Where's your other shoe?

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: I dunno. I must've dropped it.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (from her bedroom window) Hey, what's all this about the other shoe dropping?

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Buford stepped on a slug.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Okay, but be careful down there. Call me if there's any trouble. (She backs away from her window slowly, then quickly peers back out.)

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: So how's the "summer fun" coming along, Dr. Baljeet?

Name: Dr. Baljeet
Dialog: Well, since the Phineas and Ferb from the first dimension suggested we make the most of our summer, Buford and I have been experimenting with fun, and so far...

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: So far, I'd rather be breakin' rocks for the state. But, in all fairness, I do love breakin' stuff.

Name: Dr. Baljeet
Dialog: (to Phineas-2) What about you? How have you embraced your freedom?

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Fortunately, we've had a little help, thanks to the coolest pet ever.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Here, boy! Fetch!

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Cool!

Name: Ferb-2
Dialog: Any pet can fetch a stick.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: What was that noise?

Name: Dr. Baljeet
Dialog: It is some kind of metal door.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: (to Perry-2) Here, boy, pull the chain.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Whoa!

Name: Lawrence-2
Dialog: Oh, hello, boys. I see you found my secret stash.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: What is it, Dad?

Name: Lawrence-2
Dialog: Well, that's what's known as "sporting goods".

Name: Dr. Baljeet
Dialog: What do you do with them?

Name: Lawrence-2
Dialog: Back in the old days, before Youknowwho, people used to use this stuff to play sports.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Could we play sports?

Name: Lawrence-2
Dialog: Well, I don't suppose there's any reason to hide this stuff anymore. So, yes! As they used to say, "Have a ball!"

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! We're gonna use these goods and play a game of sports!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (grunts) 999...

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Good, you're home.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Monogram? Is there trouble? Do you need me?

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Hoo-hoo, stand down there. We captured Doofenshmirtz. Nothing left to resist. And it would look foolish to just stand there, resisting nothing... Well, unless you're a mime. Then it would look totally cool.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: If there's no trouble, why are you calling?

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Oh, right! Ahem. As you know, after our agents were all captured and O.W.C.A. fell, your resistance partly operated out of our old headquarters.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Yeah, so?

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Yeah, well, um, now that we're trying to rebuild our spy network, I was wondering, um, where did you put the keys?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: They're under the ceramic frog.

Name: Carl-2
Dialog: (appearing on the right side of the vanity) Oh, I love your three-monitor vanity!

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Carl will be helping me locate our animal agents so that we can—

Name: Carl-2
Dialog: (spinning around) Hey, I got my own monitor! Wee-hee!

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Carl, do you mind?

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Now, let's see. Where was I? Oh, yeah. (During this, Carl-2 appears on different sides of the vanity and mocks Monogram-2) So, yeah, if-if you get a chance, tell Agent P he can return to work anytime, and, uh, and if you see any other small animals, you can tell them to... Carl, why don't you go over and check the ceramic frog?

Name: Carl-2
Dialog: Yes, sir.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Major Monogram, do you want me to come over there and help you guys?

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: No, no. Doofenshmirtz is in jail. Everything's fine. Go-Go to your picnic and relax. Dress festive, be young! Ha. You've earned it.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: But, Major, I'm trained to—

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Leave the responsibility to us, young lady.

Name: Carl-2
Dialog: (offscreen) Look, Major Monogram, I found it!

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Carl, no! That's a real frog!

Name: Carl-2
Dialog: (offscreen) Oh.

Name: Frog
Dialog: Ribbit.

Name: Carl-2
Dialog: (offscreen) Ew!

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Yeah, I gotta run. You go have fun.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (sighs and gets her red shirt from a coat hanger) Well, I guess it's time to dress festive.

Name: Female Narrator
Dialog: Once the gong is rung, the offensive team serves the pom-pom and advances down the field. The defending cyclists race past the tackling dummies and try to get into scoring position. If they manage to return the pom-pom into one of the scoring locations, they will be awarded a chance to chase the jumbo riding ball past the midfield skiing defender, while the other team tries to hit as many tennis balls as they can using golf clubs. I don't know why this guy has a canoe paddle.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Candace? Candace? Come in, Candace!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (Takes off her shades and turns around) Isabella? Oh, hey.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Wait a minute, are you standing sentry?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (stoic) What? No. I was about to frolic down the hillside. I'm all about this whole "fun" thing.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Y'know, you're not foolin' anybody.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Yeah?

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Bo staff.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Right.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Candace, I thought you were going to take it easy. Whatever happened to that whole Jeremy Johnson thing?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: We were supposed to go out, but things kept getting in the way. I didn't have any time. I was busy.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Doing pull-ups in your room and watching your brothers?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: I like doing pull-ups.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: There's no reason you can't do that, but you have to make room in your life for other things like fun and...

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: And Jeremy Johnson?

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Something like that. In the meantime, I'd like to introduce you to a little thing the kids are calling "ice cream". (runs down the hill)

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: "I scream?" W-What is that? Some kind of weird yelling game? (following Isabella-2)

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Nice hit, Dr. Baljeet.

Name: Dr. Baljeet
Dialog: Ha ha! I believe that makes the score six kadooms to twelve rempars.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Eleven, if Perry can find the ball.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Perry!

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Come on, Ferb, we got to help him.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: What the heck is that thing?!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Ow! Ow!

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Candace, you have to eat the ice cream slowly. What is that?!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Giant mechanical ants! My brothers are in trouble! On your feet, kid, it's go time!

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: There's a flying one!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: I got it! (She fires a grappling hook at it.) Whoa!

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: (skating past Candace-2) On your right!

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Oh no! They got Perry!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Are you guys all right?

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: We're fine, but cyborg animals have captured Perry.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: The robot ants must have been a diversion. (turns on her cell phone) Monogram, we just got ambushed at the picnic. This has Doofenshmirtz written all over it.

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: (on screen) Well, that's impossible. He's right here in our detention facility. I-I-I just played checkers with him. (He cheats, by the way.)

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: These giant ants didn't send themselves!

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Ask him about the cyborg animal agents!

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: The what?! Was one of them a panda and the other one of those shaky rat dogs?

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, where'd they come from?

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Ah, well, I didn't want to say anything before, but we kind of lost track of some of the agents when Doof took over.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: How many did you lose?

Name: Carl-2
Dialog: 26, sir.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Ferb, if we can access Perry's location chip, maybe we can ambush those cyborgs and rescue Perry.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Yeah, no way! You guys are staying here where it's safe.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Candace, we can handle this. Who was it that got past the security grid to free you from Doof's tower?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Okay, but take the Firestorm Girls. It could get hairy. And while you do that, I'll go find out who's behind all this.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Come on, Ferb!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Ah, Choo-Choo, look! We have company!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: All right, Doofenshmirtz, what do you know about robotic picnic ants and a fist-full of cyborgs?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Ants at a picnic? So it's a...it's a rhetorical question, is it?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Don't play smart with me, villain. You're behind the attack at the park. Now, spill it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: What? You're blaming me? I-I-I've been locked up in here with Choo-Choo. Isn't that right, Choo-Choo? Yes. Yes, it is. See? H-He'll provide an alibi.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Don't lie to me! There's Doof-tech scattered all over that park.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Well, it wasn't me. There is, however, another Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Vanessa! I knew it!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: And who is that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Charlene Doofenshmirtz. She's my ex-wife. I-I guess you guys have never met. That kinda takes away the drama of the reveal. But it's her.

Name: Perry-2
Dialog: (Chatters angrily)

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Pinky! You're alive!

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Don't you remember me?

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Apparently not.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: We're gonna get you outta here, Perry!

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: We got Perry! Everybody fall back!

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: Now this is as much fun as bustin' rocks for the state!

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: We've had Doofenshmirtz moved into this interrogation room so Candace Flynn can question him thoroughly.

Name: Carl-2
Dialog: Are you sure he can't see you?

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: It's a one-way mirror. Here, watch this. (He makes a face at Doof-2.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: You know, I can see you!

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Oh, maybe it's just that he can't hear us.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: I can hear you, too!

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Huh. Maybe I just don't know how this one-way mirror thing works.

Name: Mover
Dialog: Comin' through.

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Oh, okay. Now I'm embarrassed.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Alright, knock it off, glamour boy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: I just haven't seen a mirror for two months. Did my hair always look like this?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Just park your caboose in that chair.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Choo-Choo is not a caboose. It's an engine.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Clam it, wise guy! You know why I'm here and you better cooperate, because there are worse things than sittin' in a cold, dank prison cell with your little choo-choo train.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Like what?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Like sitting in a cold, dank prison cell without your little choo-choo train.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: You wouldn't!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Try me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Alright, I'll talk.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Tell me about your ex-wife, Charlene.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: What do you wanna know?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (slams her Bo staff on the table) Where's her hideout?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Sheesh! She's got a penthouse uptown. You can't miss it. It has "Charlene" written in bright lights across the top of it.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: How do I get in?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: You would have to pass through the identification scrutinizer. Only a Doofenshmirtz can get through.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Lucky for us, we got one of those.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Yeah. Oh! You mean me, right?

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Dr. Baljeet, we're back and we have Perry!

Name: Dr. Baljeet
Dialog: That is great. And I think I figured out how to get this giant ant going again.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Great! So everything's going to plan?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: (offscreen) Hey, kids! (cut to reveal Doof-2 on a dolly cuffed and facemasked) Where do you keep the silverware?

Name: Isabella-2, Holly-2 and Adyson-2
Dialog: (gasp)

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: What's he doing here?!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: At ease. He's still a prisoner. I'm just using him to get into Charlene's penthouse.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Wow, cool restraints.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Actually, he asked for this stuff.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: The mask makes me sound all creepy. Here, check this out. Fava beans... Fava...

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Okay, that's enough. Hey, where's Ferb?

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Oh, well, I'm sure he'd just—

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Ugh! We don't have time to wait for him. We gotta get over to Charlene's. Phineas, Perry, you're with me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Fava beans... Heh heh heh heh...

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (to Doof-2) Now, you, do what you have to do to get us in.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Okay. Okay. (He puts his hand on the scanner, then his eye in the retina scanner.) Aaahhh... (A machine scans his tongue and ear.)

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Wow, the identity scrutinizer is really thorough.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: You have no idea. (Ding! The doors open) Come along, people.

Name: Vanessa-2
Dialog: Uh, Mom, Tony Marzulo asked me out to the movies. Can I go?

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: (getting her nails filed by a rat-borg) Didn't your father banish him?

Name: Vanessa-2
Dialog: Yeah, but Dad banished every boy that asked me to the movies. Besides, Dad's no longer in power.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: The day isn't over yet, dear.

Name: Vanessa-2
Dialog: But, Mom...

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: I don't know. (to the Rat-borg) What do you think?

Name: Rat-borg
Dialog: (squeaks)

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: There's your answer.

Name: Vanessa-2
Dialog: Uh, thanks?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Okay, fellas. There she is. Let's get her attention. (She swipes some plates off the shelf behind her with her Bo staff and the plates shatter into pieces.)

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: What the heck is goin' on in there?!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (bursting through the door) We got you now, Charlene! Your evil days are over!

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Oh, how sweet! Do come in and thank you for returning my husband.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Husband? I thought you two were divorced.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: It was all a ruse, honey.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Wait, you two are pretending to be divorced? Why would you do that?

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Naive child, let me explain.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Okay, I get it, you're still married. But why would you send the ants to the picnic? You had to know we'd come after you.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Of course. And I also knew you would use Heinz to get in the building, bringing my husband back to me and getting you here, so I could get the drop on you.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: A lot of convoluted reasons there, too.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: We've got another song! (The music starts up again.)

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: No no, we're good. (The music warps down.)

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: And now, children, we have prepared a nice cozy prison cell for you. (The animal cyborgs surround them.)

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: All the animal agents!

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Wait, you haven't seen my newest one!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (gasps offscreen) You villain! You turned my brother into a cyborg!

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Ferb-borg, relieve Candace of her weapon. (to Peter the Pandaborg) Take them to the holding cell to await cyborg reprogramming. (they leave) Oh, it's so good to have a cyborg who can actually speak.

Name: Ferb-2
Dialog: Well, I usually only say one line per day.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: One line, really? Why?

Name: Ferb-2
Dialog: (blinks)

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Seriously? That was it?

Name: Ferb-2
Dialog: (blinks)

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Eh. Weird kid.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Well, Heinz, shall we retake over the Tri-State Area now?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Actually, I-I-I don't really wanna be an evil dictator anymore. I've got everything I need right here. (He gives Choo-Choo to Charlene-2.) My Choo-Choo, my family, this lovely penthouse, my freedom and... (Cut to outside as Choo-Choo is thrown out the window.) Choo-Choo!!! Backstory reforming... Evil returning... Aw, yeah! I'm back, baby!!!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Ugh, I'm sorry I got you into this, Phineas.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Oh, that's okay, Candace.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: But we're gonna have to be strong. Jail is a mental game. They're going to try to break us, you'll see. Seconds become hours, hours become years, until the mere thought of freedom flutters out of our consciousness like a dying butterfly. (The cell door opens.)

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: You're right, that did seem like forever.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Look! It's the Ferb-borg! Get behind me, Phineas! I'll hold him off as long as I can!

Name: Ferb-2
Dialog: (takes off his disguise) Please, Candace, you're being dramatic. (frees Perry-2)

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: What? Ferb? You're not a cyborg?

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Sorry we had to fool you like that, Candace, but we needed you to be convincing.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: But why?

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Ferb figured that if Doof and Charlene thought they had the leader of the Resistance and the Platyborg under lock and key, they would devote all their attention to the frontal attack. That way, we could come up from behind and—

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Wait, what frontal attack?

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: That one.

Name: Dr. Baljeet
Dialog: (offscreen) That is not how to make it climb, Buford.

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: Oh, you wanna climb the building!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Hey, looks like someone's comin' late to the party.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: That's okay, dear. I've got a little present for our unwelcome guest. (Puts a large metal capsule on her right arm.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Wow, y-you know, Charlene, you're really on top of things here. Tomorrow, I'm taking you shopping for a new evil pantsuit.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Alright, everybody! Go go go go go!

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: So much for our ride home.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Wow, nice shot!

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: (on a walkie-talkie) Attention, all animal cyborgs, attend to our guests!

Name: Dr. Baljeet
Dialog: All we have to do is get these magnetic deprogramming chips near the cyborgs' frontal lobes and they will no longer be evil.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: How do we do that?

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: (getting a fedora out of a bag) Look, we sewed 'em into these little hats.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Aw, that's so cute!

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Everyone, grab a hat! We've got cyborgs to reprogram!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Now finish him off! (Charlene-2 is about to shoot but Candace-2 drops down.) Ahhh...

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Give it up, Charlene!

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Seems to me you're still outnumbered.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Seriously, how did he ever run this place without me?

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Alright, fan out! (Isabella-2 runs up to Pinky the Chihuahuaborg.)

Name: Pinky the Chihuahuaborg
Dialog: (growls)

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Pinky, I just wanna...

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Okay, so you're not a hat guy. Take it easy.

Name: Pinky-2
Dialog: (pants happily)

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Pinky! (she hugs him) Good to have you back! (kisses him)

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Surrender or there'll be big trouble.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Oh, I think I'll go with that second thing you mentioned.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: End of the line, kid! What a shame! I'll make ya an offer. I could get rid of you right now or you could join me. You could be the leader of my cyborg army.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (smiling) Actually, it looks like your cyborg army may have changed their minds.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Wait, what are you talking about? (Agent R-2 breaks off one of Charlene-2's fingernails.) My manicure!! (she trips over a piece of equipment) Whoa!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: It's all over, Charlene. (The reformed animal agents surround her.) Now surrender.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Ha! (presses a remote causing another capsule to come out of the floor) A Doofenshmirtz never surrenders! We fight until the last man!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Hey, wait a minute! I'm the last man! D-Don't I get a say in this?

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Oh, come on, honey. It'll be fun.

Name: Vanessa-2
Dialog: Alright, hold it! Everybody just stop! (opening the animal agents like a door) Excuse me. (to Candace-2) Can I talk to my parents? Listen, Mom, Dad, come here. You guys, I'm only gonna say this once. (breathes) RUN!!!

Name: Vanessa-2
Dialog: Mom, Dad, this is Tony Marzulo.

Name: Tony
Dialog: Hey, Mr. and Mrs. D.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Hey, didn't I banish you?

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Yeah, honey, you did, but nobody saw it.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Academy graduates, Doofenshmirtz is still out there and no doubt he's planning a comeback. But so are we. We now have you, the animal agents of OWCA, who will, without a doubt, prevail. So as I step down from my position as head of the Resistance, (Monogram-2 and Carl-2 react to this in fear) I congratulate you all and wish you luck.

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Whoa, wait! You're stepping down?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: It's okay, Major. You've got your animal agents back. I think you can handle it.

Name: Major Monogram-2
